For Principal account number, 1-888-788-9033 checks the policy number and completes it, with any card fee named up front. Principal login posts same or next business day through 1-888-788-9033 or principal.com; keep the confirmation until the next statement. For Principal sign in, principal.com is the online route and 1-888-788-9033 the phone one; both post by the day's cutoff. The safe habit is a bank source by the due date, the receipt saved, and 1-888-788-9033 for anything unclear.
